issues.title: Ingest Pulaski County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $181,901,627 across 29 funds. The largest: General Fund ($105,627,735), Road & Bridge Fund ($26,293,517), Assessor Fund ($10,552,329). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County Recorder's Cost Fund
issues.detail: The budget ordinance (p. 10) appropriates $3,021,100; the budget detail pages total $3,166,341.00. The ordinance amount is shown. Printed total is $3,021,100.00; the categories listed add to $3,166,341.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
